access_limits: Public web tool may return a crawled/cache representation; this verifies displayed passages, not author browsing history or a guaranteed origin-server network fetch.

platform_usage.actual_model_verification: Not exposed through tools to this audit worker
platform_usage.unavailable_reason: Platform token/cost telemetry is not exposed.

findings_status: All initial findings are retained. No candidate was modified by the checker. Coordinator corrections and checker rechecks remain pending.

source_access_summary.copyright_handling: Original concise assessment notes and request receipts retained; lengthy source text is not reproduced.

limitations: Twenty new IDs were deterministically sampled and twenty additional IDs were selected for risk. Their findings are reported separately and must not be pooled as an unbiased defect estimate.
Displayed current public passages support sampled claims but do not establish the author’s original browsing history, and web-tool results may be crawled/cache representations.
Unsampled cards are not certified by this audit. Identity checks are against the frozen baseline/selection context and relevant meanings, not an exhaustive external ontology reconciliation.
The one substantive scope finding requires correction and recheck before source-quality admission. Minor refinements are separately classified.
